jobs.title: AI Solution Architect (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy.     DEINE MISSION   Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren.    Deine Aufgaben:    Entwurf und Weiterentwicklung der KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur als Enterprise-KI-Plattform mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure    Technische Leitung von ML-Pipeline-Projekten, insbesondere in den Bereichen Training, Deployment, Monitoring und Drift Detection    Konzeption und Optimierung von RAG-Architekturen, beispielsweise hinsichtlich Chunking, Retrieval, Guardrails und Context Orchestration    Definition und Weiterentwicklung von MLOps-Strategien einschließlich CI/CD für Modelle, Experiment-Tracking und Model Registry    Technische Führung und Koordination interdisziplinärer Teams aus ML/AI Engineers, LLM Engineers und MLOps Engineers    Beratung interner und externer Stakeholder zu KI-Architekturen sowie Präsentation technischer Konzepte gegenüber IT-Leitung und Fachbereichen       DAS IST UNS WICHTIG     Fundierte Erfahrung mit cloudbasierten KI-/ML-Lösungen, idealerweise auf Microsoft Azure, insbesondere Azure Machine Learning und Azure OpenAI Service. Kenntnisse weiterer Cloud- und AI-Services sind von Vorteil.    Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines.    Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken.    Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex.    Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse.    Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow.    Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen.    Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights.    Grundlegendes Verständnis von AI Governance, Responsible AI sowie Sicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen im Enterprise-Umfeld.    Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ML-/AI-Architekturen oder vergleichbaren technischen Aufgaben in Enterprise-Umgebungen.    Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert.    Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.    Idealerweise Erfahrung in der Energiebranche oder Versorgungswirtschaft sowie mit datengetriebenen Anwendungsfällen.    Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.       DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ     Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.    Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.    Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich.    Individuelle

jobs.description:
Senior Systems Solutions Architect – Cloud, Virtualization & AI (Remote – California)  Full-Time, Part-Time, or Contract | Competitive Compensation + Professional Development  About GigaKOM  For more than 20 years, GigaKOM has delivered enterprise-level IT solutions to California K–12 school districts, higher education institutions, state and local government agencies, and commercial organizations. Through partnerships with leading manufacturers and technology providers, we design and deliver secure, scalable infrastructure solutions that support mission-critical environments.  As organizations continue modernizing their infrastructure, cloud platforms, identity, and data capabilities, GigaKOM is expanding its architecture and consulting capabilities. We are seeking a Senior Systems Solutions Architect to design, support, and optimize enterprise environments across Microsoft cloud services, virtualization systems, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging AI-driven technologies.  This role combines solution architecture, systems engineering, client consulting, and ongoing infrastructure support to help organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their IT environments.  Location  Remote – California  This is a fully remote position supporting client environments across California.  Position Overview  The Senior Systems Solutions Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting modern enterprise infrastructure solutions that integrate cloud services, virtualization platforms, AI-enabled technologies, identity and access management, and core enterprise systems.  This role works closely with sales teams, engineers, and client stakeholders to evaluate current environments, architect scalable solutions, support client infrastructure, and guide organizations through modernization initiatives.  In addition to solution design, this position will support client systems, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, and ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability across deployed environments.  The ideal candidate is both a strategic architect and a hands-on technologist with deep experience across Microsoft technologies (Azure, Microsoft Entra ID), virtualization platforms, and enterprise server environments.  What You’ll Do  Design Cloud, Identity & Hybrid Infrastructure Solutions  
 Architect and design hybrid and cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure and related services 
 Design and implement identity and access solutions using Microsoft Entra ID (authentication, SSO, conditional access, MFA) 
 Develop infrastructure strategies supporting scalability, resilience, and security 
 Guide organizations through cloud migration, modernization, and optimization initiatives 
 Design high-availability architectures for mission-critical workloads 
  Data Center Solution Design & Architecture  
 Lead the design of end-to-end, enterprise-grade data center solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-optimized across compute, storage, networking, virtualization, backup, and hybrid/multi-cloud environments. 
 Translate business and technical requirements into future-ready architecture, aligning solutions with client digital transformation goals, operational models, and long-term technology strategies. 
 Architect and integrate multi-vendor solutions leveraging Cisco, HPE, Dell EMC, VMware, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Veeam, ensuring seamless interoperability and optimal technology selection. 
 Develop high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), architecture diagrams, and solution blueprints covering scalability, performance, availability, and integration points. 
 Ensure alignment with industry best practices, security standards, and vendor reference architectures, while optimizing total cost of ownership (TCO) and risk mitigation. 
 Incorporate hybrid cloud, automation, and modern infrastructure principles (HCI, SDDC, orchestration) to enhance agility, operational efficiency, and service reliability.

Senior Systems Solutions Architect – Cloud, Virtualization & AI (Remote – California)  Full-Time, Part-Time, or Contract | Competitive Compensation + Professional Development  About GigaKOM  For more than 20 years, GigaKOM has delivered enterprise-level IT solutions to California K–12 school districts, higher education institutions, state and local government agencies, and commercial organizations. Through partnerships with leading manufacturers and technology providers, we design and deliver secure, scalable infrastructure solutions that support mission-critical environments.  As organizations continue modernizing their infrastructure, cloud platforms, identity, and data capabilities, GigaKOM is expanding its architecture and consulting capabilities. We are seeking a Senior Systems Solutions Architect to design, support, and optimize enterprise environments across Microsoft cloud services, virtualization systems, enterprise infrastructure, and emerging AI-driven technologies.  This role combines solution architecture, systems engineering, client consulting, and ongoing infrastructure support to help organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their IT environments.  Location  Remote – California  This is a fully remote position supporting client environments across California.  Position Overview  The Senior Systems Solutions Architect is responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting modern enterprise infrastructure solutions that integrate cloud services, virtualization platforms, AI-enabled technologies, identity and access management, and core enterprise systems.  This role works closely with sales teams, engineers, and client stakeholders to evaluate current environments, architect scalable solutions, support client infrastructure, and guide organizations through modernization initiatives.  In addition to solution design, this position will support client systems, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, and ensure optimal performance, security, and reliability across deployed environments.  The ideal candidate is both a strategic architect and a hands-on technologist with deep experience across Microsoft technologies (Azure, Microsoft Entra ID), virtualization platforms, and enterprise server environments.  What You’ll Do  Design Cloud, Identity & Hybrid Infrastructure Solutions  
 Architect and design hybrid and cloud solutions using Microsoft Azure and related services 
 Design and implement identity and access solutions using Microsoft Entra ID (authentication, SSO, conditional access, MFA) 
 Develop infrastructure strategies supporting scalability, resilience, and security 
 Guide organizations through cloud migration, modernization, and optimization initiatives 
 Design high-availability architectures for mission-critical workloads 
  Data Center Solution Design & Architecture  
 Lead the design of end-to-end, enterprise-grade data center solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-optimized across compute, storage, networking, virtualization, backup, and hybrid/multi-cloud environments. 
 Translate business and technical requirements into future-ready architecture, aligning solutions with client digital transformation goals, operational models, and long-term technology strategies. 
 Architect and integrate multi-vendor solutions leveraging Cisco, HPE, Dell EMC, VMware, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Veeam, ensuring seamless interoperability and optimal technology selection. 
 Develop high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD), architecture diagrams, and solution blueprints covering scalability, performance, availability, and integration points. 
 Ensure alignment with industry best practices, security standards, and vendor reference architectures, while optimizing total cost of ownership (TCO) and risk mitigation. 
 Incorporate hybrid cloud, automation, and modern infrastructure principles (HCI, SDDC, orchestration) to enhance agility, operational efficiency, and service reliability.

new_jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer (AI Agents)
new_jobs.description: Your mission  Join our team and build the intelligent systems at the core of Cosuno's platform.    Generative AI: Build and improve our LLM-powered systems that navigate the complex, often messy tendering workflow.    Ship end-to-end into the product: Own features from model/agent through API to the TypeScript front-end — backend service, API, and the integration into the web app.    Collaborate across teams: Work with Product, Engineering, and Data to translate business problems into shipped AI features.    Maintain production AI: Monitoring, alerting, and continuous improvement of everything we deploy.      Your profile    TypeScript, React, Node: Non-negotiable. You're comfortable shipping into our web app end-to-end — front-end, backend service, API.    Strong Python: You have 5+ years writing production-grade Python. You write clean, well-structured code.    End-to-end product delivery: You've shipped AI-powered features into a production web app and owned the integration from research code to real users.    LLM application depth: You have deep hands-on experience building and deploying LLM/agent systems — RAG, tool use, multi-step reasoning, evals.    Backend engineering skills: You design APIs, data pipelines, and services.    Product mindset: You're comfortable with ambiguity and can judge when something is good enough to ship.    Sharp problem solver: You look at a complex system, quickly identify what matters, and decide what to do next.    Bias for action: When you're unsure something will work, your instinct is to find out with data rather than keep wondering.      How We Build: Our Engineering Culture  We believe in a calm, collaborative, and productive engineering environment. We trust our engineers and give them the autonomy to do their best work. Our approach includes:    Agile & Fast-Paced: We practice trunk-based development with daily releases to get value into our users' hands quickly.    Quality by Default: We maintain a comprehensive Cypress E2E test suite and enforce strict typing, linting, and formatting rules to keep our codebase clean and maintainable.    DevOps Mindset: Our well-oiled CI/CD pipeline deploys to AWS via Kubernetes, with our entire infrastructure managed as code using Terraform.    Collaboration & Transparency: We value open discussion, constructive code reviews, and a culture where the best idea wins, regardless of who it comes from.      Why us?    Competitive Compensation: A competitive salary above the market average.    Work-Life Balance: Choose to work 100% remotely or from our modern office in Berlin. We offer flexible working hours to fit your life.    Top-Notch Equipment: A new MacBook Pro to ensure you have the best tools for the job.    A Great Team: Regular company off-sites and team events that connect us as people, not just colleagues.    Job Security: A permanent contract in a stable, well-funded company.      About us  Cosuno – Revolutionizing construction through technology.  We are Cosuno – a fast-growing tech startup that is making the construction industry more efficient and transparent with our digital platform for tenders and procurement processes. Our goal: to solve the most complex challenges in the industry with innovation and simplicity.   Why Cosuno?   Artificial intelligence is the key to our solution: it analyzes millions of price data points and helps construction companies create precise and efficient bids. This not only saves our customers time but also helps them avoid unnecessary costs.  But for us, it's not just about technology – it's about the people who drive it. At Cosuno, you will work with creative minds who are reshaping the construction industry. We believe in diversity because we know that the best ideas come from different perspectives. An integrative and inclusive work environment is a matter of course for us.   Join us – Build the future of construction.
